title: Livesync And Animation Export
description:
Welcome to the tutorial on Marvelous Designer LiveSync and Animation Export
- This is an overview video on variety of opinions to export Cloth animation cache created from Marvelous Designer to Unreal Engine.  We will go over the export settings for FBX, Alembic and USD file format, as well as how to use Marvelous Designer LiveSync

You can find more details on how to download and setup Marvelous Designer LiveSync from the videos bellow: 
Download Marvelous Designer LiveSync: https://connect.clo-set.com/livesync
Setting up Unreal Engine & LiveSync plugin: https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/8924200985359-Setting-up-Unreal-Engine-LiveSync-plugin
Setting up LiveSync Video Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hB9S-rYm98M
